display_long_description:
A single-player VR fighting game inspired by backyard brawls and anything-goes street fights.

🥊 TRAIN IN THE GYM
Your gym is your main menu. Hammer the heavy bags, work the speed bag and spar in the cage while other fighters train around you.

👊 SEVEN FIGHTERS
Each with his own power. Rook pushes with the force and throws energy balls. The Gun Fighter has a pistol, grenades and a baton. The White Knight fights with sword and shield, Eclipse with magic, Red Eyes with rage kicks and twin swords, the Cage Fighter with a power surge, and Ventress with her bow and fire arrows.

🏆 CLIMB THE LADDER
Pick a fighter and beat the other six in turn, champion last. Train between fights to make him stronger. Easy, Normal or Hard.

⚔️ THE GAUNTLET
Fight until you lose. Every fight is harder than the last, your damage carries over, and you pick a perk after each win.

⏱️ WORKOUT
Set your rounds and go, on the bags or sparring. It counts your punches, your speed and your hardest shots. You will work up a sweat.

🔥 SIX VENUES
A factory, a backyard, a beach cove, a volcano, a rainy city rooftop and a space station in orbit.

💥 HITS THAT SHOW
Hard strikes feel and sound different from slaps. Fighters bruise, cut and bleed.

👕 MAKE IT YOURS
Change your fighter's face, body and outfit, and unlock new colours by climbing the ladder.

🕹️ COMFORT
Smooth walking and snap turning. Built for Quest 2, 3 and 3S.

⚠️ EARLY ACCESS
Expect new moves, fighters and fixes with every update.
